title: Sanctions GKG share leads Yara returns (short)
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] GDELT sanctions GKG share 20d z-score > 1.5 leads Yara returns by 2 days (-) via European gas feedstock cost; trade short YAR.OL 4d [gdelt.gkg.sanctions_share -> finance.YAR.OL.log_return]
message: Noise: sanctions share vs YAR.OL r=-0.03 (n=386, perm p=0.60, Bonferroni 1.0); short rule 44 trades hit 0.48, excess +0.05%, actionability 6.26 driven by 13 OOS war trades (hit 0.62). Not a repeatable rule.

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.sanctions_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short YAR next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] GDELT sanctions GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads TTF gas futures returns by 3 days (+), testing the feedstock-cost leg directly since the Yara short was noise (perm p=0.60) despite OOS hit 0.62; trade long TTF=F 3d [gdelt.gkg.sanctions_share -> finance.TTF=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0033)
